commandHostNote:
---
**OpenCode host note (managed).** Run the workflow described above by calling the `workflow.run` tool (in Code Mode: `tools.workflow.run({ script })`) with the JavaScript script you author. The same API applies: `agent(prompt, {label, agentType: 'grok-bitch:<name>', phase, schema, model, timeoutMs, worktree})`, `parallel([() => ...])`, `pipeline(items, ...stages)`, `phase(title)`, `log(msg)`. The tool returns `{runId, ok, value, phases, logs, receipts}`; `ok:false` means a child failed and must be reported as a failure, never as done. `agentType` maps to OpenCode agent IDs `grok-bitch/<name>`. There is no `/workflows` pane: inspect runs with `workflow.status({runId})` and the child sessions in the session list.
